title: post auth v1 token grant type password with valid credentials
description: Test POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password with valid apikey and correct email and password in JSON body. Expect 200 response with access_token and user object for successful authentication.

title: get rest v1 orders select id user id status with valid jwt
description: Test GET /rest/v1/orders?select=id,user_id,status with valid apikey and Bearer JWT. Verify response returns only orders belonging to the authenticated user and status 200.

title: post rest v1 orders insert valid order with correct user id
description: Test POST /rest/v1/orders with apikey, Bearer JWT, Prefer:return=representation header, and valid order body where user_id equals auth.uid(). Expect 201 response with inserted order representation.

title: post rest v1 orders insert order with unknown field
description: Test POST /rest/v1/orders with apikey, Bearer JWT, and body containing an unknown field such as currency. Expect 400 response with PGRST204 error and no order inserted.

title: post rest v1 orders insert order with mismatched user id
description: Test POST /rest/v1/orders with apikey, Bearer JWT, but user_id in body not equal to auth.uid(). Expect 403 response due to RLS violation and insert rejected.

title: post rest v1 rpc wallet get balance with valid jwt and user id
description: Test POST /rest/v1/rpc/wallet_get_balance with apikey, Bearer JWT, and body containing p_user_id equal to auth.uid(). Expect 200 response with free_cents, tokens_balance, and last_transactions data.

title: post functions v1 notify client with valid jwt and complete body
description: Test POST /functions/v1/notify-client with apikey, Bearer JWT, and body containing user_id, title, and body fields. Verify request is accepted and does not return 401 unauthorized error.
